title: KCP disclosure_manifest_show result (DESIGN.md §16.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for disclosure_manifest_show (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The visible DisclosureManifest projection (gap note KG4); provider claims are recorded assertions, not independently proven facts (§16.2).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

disclosureItem.description: DisclosureManifest exact_items[] entry, field names verbatim §16.2; the authorization binds the final bytes/references that leave, not merely a broad topic name (§16.2).

recipient_kind.description: Recipient kind token (§16.2 names the field with no value space; gap note KG6).

items.description: Data class label (§16.2); the authorization binds the final bytes/references that leave, not merely a broad topic name.

disclosureManifest.description: DisclosureManifest projection, field names verbatim from the §16.2 record shape (gap note KG4).

kind.description: Transformation kind token; calling something redacted without a result digest is insufficient (§16.2).

disclosureTransformation.description: DisclosureManifest transformations[] entry, field names verbatim §16.2.

freeText.description: Bounded free text. §11.8 bounds free text again at admission; the 4096-scalar schema ceiling is the recorded extraction bound (ops README gap note KG8).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

region.description: Recorded provider assertion, not an independently proven fact (§16.2).

retention.description: Recorded provider assertion, not an independently proven fact (§16.2).

training_use.description: Recorded provider assertion, not an independently proven fact (§16.2).

providerClaims.description: DisclosureManifest provider_claims {region, retention, training_use}, verbatim §16.2; recorded assertions, not independently proven facts.

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
